response.coverage: Domestic arrivals reported to BTS; all reporting carriers in the selected period.

definitions.operation_rates: All four operation percentages use reported_operations, including cancellations and diversions, as their denominator.
definitions.delayed_arrivals: Gate arrivals 15 or more minutes after schedule; total minus on-time, cancelled, and diverted operations.
definitions.average_delay: Delayed minutes divided by delayed arrivals; excludes on-time, cancelled, and diverted operations.

source.name: BTS Airline On-Time Statistics and Delay Causes

response.limitations: Aggregate period totals do not verify completeness of each month's reporting. Coverage differs from T-100 commercial traffic; do not combine their flight denominators. NAS delay includes weather, traffic, ATC, and airport operations; it does not isolate infrastructure constraints. This report provides no taxi times, physical capacity utilization, or measured unmet demand.
